p007.lead: The Eternal Son upholds the world of spirit, draws near to creatures through bestowal, and reveals the Father: the paper on the Son’s relation to the universe.

p007.foot.text: Indited by a Divine Counselor assigned to formulate this statement depicting the Eternal Son of Paradise

p007.s0.h: Introduction — The One Who Upholds the World of Spirit
p007.s0.b0: If Paper 6 introduced who the Eternal Son is, Paper 7 deals with the relation the Son sustains to the universe. As the Father’s eternal purpose unfolds in the evolving universes, the Original Son is ever concerned with carrying out its **spiritual aspects**. Just as the Isle of Paradise upholds all things material, the Second Source and Center is the counterpoise who upholds spirit realities.

p007.s0.b1.q: The spirit world is the habit, the personal conduct, of the Son

p007.s0.b2: That does not mean everything in the spirit world happens as the Son wills. The will of personal creatures is relatively free, so the conduct of spirit personalities does not always truly represent the Son’s character. Even so, the Son’s gravity control over all spirit realities remains absolute. This picture, in which freedom and order exist side by side, underlies the whole of Paper 7.
p007.s0.b3: To sum up: on the material side the Father is revealed in the beauty of the patterns of the central Isle, and on the spiritual side in the spiritual values of the Eternal Son’s personality. The Isle and the Son are two counterpoised partners. Keeping this pattern in mind makes the later comparison between spirit gravity and physical gravity far easier to follow.
p007.s1.h: I. The Spirit-Gravity Circuit — A Pull That Responds to Quality
p007.s1.b0: The key concept of the first section is **spirit gravity**. The pure spirit gravity of all creation is an exclusively spiritual circuit leading directly back to the Eternal Son on Paradise, and through it the Son holds all true spirit values. The paper sums it up this way: the control of universal spiritual gravity is universal spiritual sovereignty.
p007.s1.b1: Spirit gravity resembles physical gravity but differs from it decisively. Physical gravity responds to mass—to quantity—while spirit gravity responds to quality. It is also independent of time and space, so it is neither weakened nor delayed by distance.

head: Physical gravity
Spirit gravity
rows: Decreases with the square of the distance
Affected by the mass of the material creation

p007.s1.b3.q: From the viewpoint of personality, spirit is the soul of creation; matter is the shadowy physical body.

p007.s1.b4: This pull does not act only on the universe as a whole. There is also a direct attraction between spiritually minded people of like longings, so “kindred spirits” is not merely a figure of speech. And while sin and rebellion can disturb the local universe circuits, they cannot halt the Son’s spirit gravity itself. Even Urantia, quarantined after the Lucifer rebellion, is not outside this circuit.

p007.s1.b5.q: Sin and rebellion may interfere with the operation of local universe circuits, but nothing can suspend the spirit gravity of the Eternal Son.

p007.s1.b6: This section also touches on the relation with the Deity Absolute. The Eternal Son dominates the realm of actual spirit values, while the Deity Absolute seems to pervade the domain of potential spirit values. So most spiritual reactions are predictable, but in the realm of emerging potentials there are phenomena that are not.
p007.s1.b7: The last paragraph of the section summarizes the cycle of spirit. Spirit emerges from the potentials of the Deity Absolute, finds correlation in the experiential grasp of the Supreme and the Ultimate, and at last finds final destiny in the absolute spirit gravity of the Eternal Son. Our own spiritual growth is part of this great current, and no spiritual value that becomes actual is ever lost.
p007.s2.h: II. The Administration of the Eternal Son — From Paradise to the Local Universe
p007.s2.b0: The Son’s personal activity is most profound and absolute on Paradise and is detected less and less as one moves outward. This does not mean his influence weakens. Rather, the way the Son is present differs at each level of the universe.

head: Realm
How the Eternal Son is present
rows: His personal presence and activity are profound and absolute
Discerned in the perfect spiritual harmony of the eternal creation
Not personally resident; only a superpersonal representation
Personally present in the persons of the Creator Sons

p007.s2.b2: In the superuniverses the Son’s administration is exclusively spiritual and superpersonal, so creatures can hardly discern it. In the local universes it is different: there we meet the Eternal Son close at hand in the Creator Son. The One who is so far away comes to us with a personal face at the place nearest to us.
p007.s3.h: III. Relation of the Eternal Son to the Individual — The Path Prayer Travels
p007.s3.b0: The Son’s spirit does not indwell our minds as the Adjuster does. Yet at every stage of the ascent his beneficence is near and concerned with the welfare of the children of time. And spirit gravity is the inherent secret of the human soul’s Paradise ascension. The mortal mind begins as a material mechanism but becomes ever less subject to material gravity and more responsive to spirit gravity.

p007.s3.b1.q: The spirit-gravity circuit literally pulls the soul of man Paradiseward.

p007.s3.b2: The most practical teaching of this section concerns prayer. The spirit-gravity circuit is the basic channel that carries sincere prayer to the consciousness of Deity, and whatever in our petitions has true spiritual value passes simultaneously to all the divine personalities concerned. So it does not matter whether we picture the Creator Son or the Eternal Son when we pray. The paper compares this sorting process to the neural circuits of the body.

head: Content of the prayer
What happens in the spirit circuit
rows: Thoughts filled with the highest spiritual values
Once expressed, nothing can prevent their passing directly to the absolute spirit personality
Find no place in the spirit circuit; they fall dead

p007.s3.b4.q: It is the motivating thought, the spiritual content, that validates the mortal supplication. Words are valueless.

p007.s4.h: IV. The Divine Perfection Plans — Three Universal Enterprises
p007.s4.b0: The Father and the Son are as one in the gigantic plan for lifting the material beings of time to the perfection of eternity, and the Infinite Spirit co-operates with them. The plan is made up of three correlated enterprises.

head: Plan
Proposed by
What it does
rows: Lifts evolutionary creatures through the bestowal of Thought Adjusters and of personality
The Sons of God are bestowed to make real the Father’s love and the Son’s mercy, and act as rehabilitators in rebellion
The ministry that makes the attainment and bestowal enterprises effective

p007.s4.b2: The bestowal plan also has the character of an emergency provision. When rebellion delays the attainment plan, the Paradise Sons stand pledged to go into those realms as retrievers. On Urantia a Creator Son performed exactly this service. Having proclaimed the mandate, “⟦Q 7:4.7⟧Be you perfect,⟦/Q⟧” the Father entrusted its execution to the Eternal Son.
p007.s5.h: V. The Spirit of Bestowal — Coming as the Creature Itself
p007.s5.b0: Because the Eternal Son’s personality cannot be fragmented, he cannot come to us as the Father does through the Adjuster. Instead, the Son draws near through a series of downstepping gradations of divine sonship until at last he stands in man’s presence—and at times as man himself. This is the **technique of bestowal**.

head: The Universal Father
The Eternal Son
rows: How he comes to the creature
The indwelling of the prepersonal Thought Adjuster
The incarnation of the Paradise Sons
The bestowal experiences of the Sons

p007.s5.b2: When Michael of Nebadon incarnated as Jesus of Nazareth, the Eternal Son truly came to mortal man on Urantia. Long, long ago the Eternal Son also bestowed himself on the seven circuits of Havona, and the original Michael, the first-born Creator Son, personally journeyed through the circuits with the ascending pilgrims. This is an encouragement to every pilgrim passing through Havona.

p007.s5.b3.q: the Eternal Son of God seven times abdicated the power and glory of Paradise to participate in the experiences of the time-space pilgrims

p007.s5.b4.q: It is literally true, whosoever has seen a Paradise Son has seen the Eternal Son of God.

p007.s5.b5: The spirit of bestowal is not found in the Eternal Son alone. The Creator Sons, the Magisterial Sons, and orders of sonship not yet revealed all share this willingness to give themselves as the creatures themselves. So whenever any Son is bestowed, it becomes true that the Eternal Son has bestowed himself in that bestowal. The principle that the higher a being is, the lower it stoops to serve also sets an example of service for us.
p007.s6.h: VI. The Paradise Sons of God
p007.s6.b0: The paper says that ignorance of the many Sons of God is a source of great confusion on Urantia. The Paradise Sons are classified according to which Deities personalized them. The Creator Sons are potentially equal with the Father and the Son in spirit nature, wisdom, and creative power, yet they can administer only what they bring into existence.

head: Order of Sons
Personalized by
Chief service
rows: Organize and rule the local universes
Earn through creature incarnation the right to serve as judges of survival
The Father, the Son, and the Spirit
Supernal teachers of both human and divine personalities

p007.s6.b2: Between the Eternal Son and all these Sons there is a direct and exclusive channel of communication, distinct from the spirit-gravity circuit. So the Son always has perfect knowledge of the thoughts and activities of every Paradise Son, as well as of every spiritual value in the hearts of all creatures.
p007.s7.h: VII. The Supreme Revelation of the Father
p007.s7.b0: The last section is the conclusion of the paper. The Eternal Son is the complete and final revelation of the Father’s spirit and personality. The Father’s character could not be improved upon in the Son, but it is amplified for creatures by being divested of the nonpersonal and nonspiritual.

p007.s7.b1.q: The Father comes down to you as a personality only through the divine Sons of the Eternal Son.

p007.s7.b2: The paper then adds a word of comfort for ascenders. To beings who were once human, the Eternal Son will be easier to approach than the Father, and in Havona we will attain the Son long before we can discern the Father. What we can do now is meditate on the life of our own Creator Son, who lived on earth as the Son of Man.

p007.s7.b3.q: the Son of Man and the Son of God

p007.s8.b0: Paper 7 may look like abstract theology, but it touches our inner life deeply. Because spirit gravity responds to quality, the quality of the thoughts and motives we hold determines where we are being drawn. Prayer rises not by the length of its words but by its spiritual content, and the Father comes nearest to us through the lives of his bestowal Sons.

head: Practice
The teaching behind it
rows: When you pray, examine your motive before your words
It is the spiritual content that validates a petition
Turn self-centered requests into longings for spiritual values
Selfish requests do not ascend in the spirit circuit
Share spiritual fellowship with those of like longings
There is a direct attraction between spiritually minded persons
Come to know the Father by meditating on the life of Jesus
The Father comes to us as a personality through his Sons

p007.s8.b2: Paper 8 introduces the Third Person of Deity, the Infinite Spirit, and Paper 9 takes up that Spirit’s relation to the universe. There we can follow how the plan of mercy ministry—one of the three perfection plans met in Paper 7—unfolds.
p008.lead: The God of Action, who carries out the Father’s love and the Son’s mercy as ministry: the paper that introduces the Infinite Spirit, the Third Person of Deity.

p008.foot.text: Presented on Urantia by a Divine Counselor of Uversa commissioned by the Ancients of Days to portray the nature and work of the Infinite Spirit

p008.s0.h: Introduction — After Thought and Word Comes Action
p008.s0.b0: If Paper 6 told us that the Father’s “first” thought found its expression in the Eternal Son, the Word, Paper 8 tells of the next step. The Thought-God and the Word-God desire an infinite agent for mutual expression and combined action. The very moment the two conjointly conceive one infinite action—the execution of an absolute thought-plan—the Infinite Spirit, the Third Person of Deity, springs full-fledged into existence.
p008.s0.b1: Underlying this eternal event is a **covenant**. In the dawn of eternity the Father and the Son become infinitely cognizant of their mutual dependence and absolute oneness, and they enter into a divine partnership to carry out their united concepts forever. The Infinite Spirit appears precisely where this partnership passes into action. From the beginning, then, the Spirit is the God of relationship and co-operation.

head: Person of Deity
The figure used in this paper
Role
rows: The perfect expression of that thought
The execution of the united thought and word

p008.s0.b3: This sequence, however, is not an event in time. The author makes clear that he recites the order of origin only to help us think about their relationship. All three exist from eternity, without beginning or ending of days.

p008.s0.b4.q: They are and always have been and ever shall be.

p008.s1.h: I. The God of Action — The Stage of Creation Is Set
p008.s1.b0: With the personalization of the Infinite Spirit, the divine personality cycle becomes complete. The Spirit’s first act is to recognize his divine parents, the Father and the Son; his next act is remarkable. Though equal with them, he voluntarily pledges eternal loyalty to the Father and acknowledges everlasting dependence on the Son. In this mutual recognition the Paradise Trinity comes into being.
p008.s1.b1: When the God of Action functions, the dead vaults of space are astir, and one billion perfect spheres flash into existence. This section pictures the scene of creation in several stages.

head: Stage
What happened
rows: A billion worlds materialize, and Paradise gravity appears to hold them
The second form of energy, spirit, flows out and is grasped by the spiritual gravity of the Son
The soil is prepared for the consciousness of mind in the intelligence circuits of the Infinite Spirit
The Father acts, and creature personalities appear

p008.s1.b3: The Infinite Spirit eternalizes concurrently with the birth of Havona, and by this act of conjoint creation he becomes forever the Conjoint Creator. No records exist of anything before this event. The paper is also frank about why it explains things in sequence: the material mind needs a First Cause and a starting point for consistency.

p008.s1.b4.q: Beyond this event lie the unsearchable transactions of eternity and the depths of infinity—absolute mystery.

p008.s1.b5: The paper goes on to explain that we grasp reality the way a child does—first mastering the relationship with its parents, then gradually enlarging the concept to the family, the community, the world, and the universe. Our way of coming to know God likewise begins with close relationships and widens step by step.
p008.s2.h: II. Nature of the Infinite Spirit — A Spirit Inclined Toward Mercy
p008.s2.b0: The Infinite Spirit reflects perfectly the nature of both the Father and the Son, and he is known by many names. Each name throws light on one aspect of the Spirit.

head: Group of names
The aspect it reveals
rows: Conjoint Creator · Conjoint Actor · Divine Executive
He carries out the plans of the Father and the Son
He is the source of mind
Universal Spirit · Spirit of Spirits · Omnipresent Spirit
Supreme Guide · Final Co-ordinator · Paradise Mother Spirit

p008.s2.b2: The Infinite Spirit shares all the Father’s perfection, righteousness, and love, yet he inclines especially toward the Son’s attributes of **mercy**. So the Spirit becomes the mercy minister of the Deities to the grand universe. The Spirit does not have more goodness than the Father, but through his ministry we come to understand that goodness better.
p008.s2.b3: This section also shows consideration for those who think in material terms. Creatures who tend to view matter as basic reality would better comprehend the Third Source and Center, it says, if he were called the Infinite Reality, the Universal Organizer, or the Personality Co-ordinator. And because the Conjoint Creator most strikingly discloses the Father’s infinity, even an infinitely expanding universe would find his spirit presence, energy control, and mind potential fully adequate.

p008.s2.b4.q: as the divine Sons reveal the love of God, so the divine Spirit depicts the mercy of God

p008.s2.b5: The explanation that the Spirit is not better than the Father, but that the Father’s goodness becomes real to us through the Spirit, means much for the life of faith. The Father’s faithfulness and the Son’s constancy usually become real through the concrete ministry and service of the Spirit’s personalities. It is much like someone who has known God’s love only as an idea first feeling it while being cared for by another.
p008.s3.h: III. Relation of the Spirit to the Father and the Son — The Way to the Father
p008.s3.b0: Since the personalization of the Third Source, the Father no longer personally participates in universe creation; he delegates everything possible to the Son. The Son in turn bestows all possible authority and power on the Conjoint Creator. Our own local universe was made by a Creator Son and a Creative Spirit together, and the care of its creatures is entrusted to these two.
p008.s3.b1: This chain of delegation shows that God is not one who clutches authority but one who shares it. And in all later creation the Infinite Spirit sustains the same personal relation to the Son that the Son sustains to the Father in the first and central creation. The relationships of the Deities repeat the same pattern from above to below.
p008.s3.b2: The very instant the Son accepted the Father’s plan of perfection attainment, the Infinite Spirit became its conjoint administrator and pledged all his resources to it. The heart of this section is the order laid out along the path of ascent.

p008.s3.b3.q: The Eternal Son is the only avenue of approach to the Universal Father, and the Infinite Spirit is the only means of attaining the Eternal Son.

head: Order in which ascenders meet them
Why
rows: The Third Person enshrouds the Second and the First and so is always recognized first
Discovered only by the patient ministry of the Spirit
The Son is the only avenue of approach to the Father

p008.s3.b5: This order is not a hierarchy of faith but the path that love travels. That the first one we meet on the way to the Father is the Spirit, the minister of mercy, means that the first step of ascent always begins amid help and care. No one reaches the Father alone.
p008.s4.h: IV. The Spirit of Divine Ministry — Love, Mercy, Ministry
p008.s4.b0: The fourth section sums up the Spirit’s character in a word. Everlasting ministry to mind is the essence of the Spirit, and all his offspring share his divine urge to serve.

p008.s4.b1.q: God is love, the Son is mercy, the Spirit is ministry

head: Deity
Core character
How it is shown
rows: Reveals love through the bestowals of the divine Sons
Applies love and mercy to the creature creation

p008.s4.b3: The Spirit does not come down in mortal flesh as the Sons do. Instead, he joyfully undergoes a series of divinity attenuations, stepping down and down until he appears as angels who stand at our side and guide us through the lowly paths of earthly life. In the local universe, in the person of the Mother Spirit, he is devoted to fostering creatures toward higher spiritual levels. And all the while his existence as the Third Person at the center of all things is not diminished in the least.
p008.s4.b4: In Havona the Infinite Spirit fully participated in the seven appearances of the Eternal Son and in the seven bestowals of the original Michael. So the Spirit became a sympathetic and understanding minister to every pilgrim of time who passes through those perfect circuits. The Spirit’s mercy is not pity looking down from above; it springs from an understanding gained by sharing the experience.

p008.s4.b5.q: Indeed is this Spirit “the eyes of the Lord which are ever over the righteous” and “the divine ears which are ever open to their prayers.”

p008.s5.h: V. The Presence of God — Many Spirits Working as One
p008.s5.b0: The outstanding attribute of the Infinite Spirit is omnipresence. The paper points out that in sacred writings the term “⟦Q 8:5.3⟧Spirit of God⟦/Q⟧” seems to refer interchangeably to the Infinite Spirit on Paradise and to the Creative Spirit of the local universe. The Holy Spirit is a circuit indigenous to the local universe Mother Spirit and confined to that universe, but the Infinite Spirit is present everywhere.
p008.s5.b1: The spiritual influences at work within us are many, but they are not divided against one another. Even the work of the Adjusters always coincides with the ministry of the Infinite Spirit and the Mother Spirit. Their origins differ, yet in our minds and souls they function as one spirit.
p008.s5.b2: So the paper explains why the spirit presence of the Infinite Spirit is often called “⟦Q 8:5.5⟧the spirit of God.⟦/Q⟧” Because the Spirit is the Conjoint Actor, he is present not only as himself but also as the Father, as the Son, and as the Father-Son. That is why it is consistent to call the liaison of all spiritual ministry the spirit of God.

p008.s5.b3.q: There are many spiritual influences, and they are all as one.

p008.s6.h: VI. Personality of the Infinite Spirit
p008.s6.b0: Because the Spirit’s bestowal is so widely spread, we can easily think of him as merely an impersonal force or influence. The paper warns against that misunderstanding. The Infinite Spirit is a universe presence, a cosmic power, and a universal mind, but he is also a true and divine personality. He has mind and will; he loves, and he sorrows.
p008.s6.b1: This section gathers scriptural passages that show the Spirit’s personality. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God; he divides his gifts to each one as he wills; he makes intercession for us. The saying that those led by the Spirit of God are the sons of God is also offered as evidence that the Spirit influences us directly and personally.

p008.s6.b2.q: therefore “Grieve not the Spirit of God.”

p008.s6.b3: In the Infinite Spirit the Father and the Son are mutually present. The Spirit is like the Father, like the Son, and like the Father and the Son as they two are forever one. So in the administration of the universes the three work perfectly and eternally interlocked.
p008.s7.b0: The Infinite Spirit of Paper 8 is not a distant, abstract force but a person who steps down even to the touch of an angel to come to our side. It is through the Spirit’s ministry that the Father’s love and the Son’s mercy actually reach our lives. And the picture of One who is equal yet freely confesses loyalty and dependence shows that service is never a lowly thing.

head: Practice
The teaching behind it
rows: Offer someone one small act of ministry today
The Spirit inclines toward the Son’s mercy
Receive the various spiritual leadings within you as one guidance
Many spiritual influences are all as one
Do not grieve the Spirit by your words and deeds
The Spirit is a person who loves and sorrows

p008.s7.b2: Paper 9 goes on to the Infinite Spirit’s relation to the universe—especially his work as the source of mind and his many offspring. If we read it remembering the ministering Spirit met in Paper 8, we will see that all that vast activity flows in the end from a single love.
p009.lead: The Third Source and Center, who manipulates energy, bestows mind, and co-ordinates all reality: the paper on how the Infinite Spirit relates to the universe.

p009.foot.text: Revealed on Urantia by a Divine Counselor of Uversa commissioned by the Ancients of Days

p009.s0.b0: If Paper 8 introduces who the Infinite Spirit is, Paper 9 turns to what the Spirit does in the universe. It opens with a strange fact. Nothing in the eternity situation foreshadowed that the Conjoint Actor would personalize as a spirit co-ordinated with absolute mind and endowed with unique prerogatives of energy manipulation. Yet with the Spirit’s coming into being, the Father is fully liberated from the bonds of centralized perfection and the fetters of personality absolutism.
p009.s0.b1: This liberation shows itself in the Spirit’s power to create beings fit to serve as ministering spirits even to material creatures. Where the Father does not go directly, the Spirit and his offspring go, down to the humblest levels. The paper then sets the four great realities side by side and shows the distinctive part the Spirit plays among them.

head: Reality
Infinite in
Role in the universe
rows: Love and volition, spiritual thought and purpose
Wisdom and truth, spiritual expression and interpretation
Potential for force endowment and capacity for energy dominance
Prerogatives of synthesis; capacity to co-ordinate all energies, spirits, and intellects

p009.s0.b3.q: His influence and personalities are ever near you; they really know and truly understand you.

p009.s1.h: I. Attributes of the Third Source and Center
p009.s1.b0: Each of the many names of the Third Source and Center points to a relationship or a function. God the Spirit, the Infinite Spirit, the Universal Manipulator, the Conjoint Actor, the Absolute Mind, the God of Action: every name shows a different face. Some of his attributes come from the Father and some from the Son, but others are observed in neither. The paper explains these by linking them to the absoluteness of Paradise.
p009.s1.b1: If we picture the Father as an original creator and the Son as a spiritual administrator, we should think of the Spirit as a universal co-ordinator, a minister of unlimited co-operation. No actual reality can escape eventual relationship with the Third Source. The paper adds one qualification to the Spirit’s omnipotence: he is actually omnipotent only in the domain of mind, and there his sovereignty is unqualified.
p009.s1.b2: The section closes with some of the warmest sentences in the paper. The Spirit is endowed with patience, mercy, and love no less superbly than with power over energy. Even the hard process through which our universe is being shaped has been placed in the hands of the children of mercy.

p009.s1.b3.q: The Spirit is supremely competent to minister love and to overshadow justice with mercy.

p009.s1.b4.q: The universe of your origin is being forged out between the anvil of justice and the hammer of suffering; but those who wield the hammer are the children of mercy, the spirit offspring of the Infinite Spirit.

p009.s2.h: II. The Omnipresent Spirit — God Is Spirit in a Threefold Sense
p009.s2.b0: God is spirit in a threefold sense. He himself is spirit; in his Son he appears as spirit without qualification; and in the Conjoint Actor he appears as spirit allied with mind. Just as the Son is a complement of the Father, the Infinite Spirit is a complement of the Son.

p009.s2.b1.q: The Eternal Son is a spiritualized personalization of the Father; the Infinite Spirit is a personalized spiritualization of the Eternal Son and the Universal Father.

p009.s2.b2: The people of Urantia are linked with the Deities of Paradise through many lines of spiritual connection. The section names these connections one by one and then stresses that they all act in unison, in perfect co-operation.

head: Connection
Source
How far humans can be aware of it
rows: Can become conscious of it in some degree
Presence of the Infinite Spirit through the local universe
Leads the true of purpose upward and inward

p009.s3.h: III. The Universal Manipulator — The God of Action and Energy
p009.s3.b0: The Isle of Paradise is the source of physical gravity, and gravity is among the most dependable things in the whole universe. Yet gravity can be modified or annulled only by forces entrusted to the Third Source and Center. The Infinite Spirit possesses a unique power, **antigravity**, which is not observably present in either the Father or the Son.
p009.s3.b1: Antigravity annuls gravity within a local frame by exerting an equal force presence, and it acts only on material gravity. The Spirit also displays powers that transcend force and neutralize energy, slowing energy down to the point of materialization. The universe is filled with creatures entrusted with such work: physical controllers, power directors, power centers, and others.

p009.s3.b2.q: The Conjoint Creator is not energy nor the source of energy nor the destiny of energy; he is the manipulator of energy.

p009.s3.b3: This does not mean that the Spirit works for Paradise. Paradise is not a person; the Spirit acts personally for the Father and the Son. Even those doings of the Spirit that look impersonal are all his own volitional acts. The paper sums up the relationship in a short pair of parallels.

head: Paradise
The God of Action
rows: The levers of intelligence that motivate the material level
A person acting volitionally for the Father and the Son

p009.s4.h: IV. The Absolute Mind — Energy Is Thing, Mind Is Meaning, Spirit Is Value
p009.s4.b0: The Third Source has an intellectual nature distinct from his physical and spiritual attributes. The absolute mind is the mind of the Third Person and is inseparable from the personality of God the Spirit. Mind is not inherent in energy, though it can be superimposed upon it; and mind does not need to be added to pure spirit, for spirit is innately conscious.
p009.s4.b1: The mind endowment of the seven superuniverses comes from the Seven Master Spirits, and our local universe is pervaded by the Nebadon variant of the Orvonton type of cosmic mind. Mind stands in a different relation to time and space at each of its levels.

p009.s4.b3.q: Energy is thing, mind is meaning, spirit is value.

p009.s4.b4: This short sentence may be the most useful key in the whole paper. Mind transmutes the values of spirit into the meanings of intellect, and volition brings those meanings to fruit in both the material and the spiritual domains. Personality then unifies the growth that takes place in spirit, mind, and energy. When we come to understand something and carry it into choice and action, that very process becomes the material of our ascent.
p009.s5.h: V. The Ministry of Mind — Divine Origin, Immature Present
p009.s5.b0: Creature mind has its origin solely in the Third Source and Center. The Spirit is the bestower of mind, and even the Adjusters, fragments of the Father, cannot indwell human minds until the way has been prepared by the Spirit’s mind action. Through the adjutants the Spirit ministers to human and subhuman intellect, and through the physical controllers even to the most primitive forms of life.
p009.s5.b1: This is why evolutionary creatures find it easier to form concepts of the Infinite Spirit than of the Son or the Father: the very existence of our minds discloses, however imperfectly, the reality of the Conjoint Creator. But the paper immediately adds an important warning.

p009.s5.b2.q: The Conjoint Creator is the source of mind, but mind is not the Conjoint Creator.

p009.s5.b3: Human intellect is rooted in the material origin of the animal races, so we must not assume that every phenomenon of mind is divine. All too often we mar our minds by insincerity, subject them to animal fear, and distort them by useless anxiety. Mind has a divine origin and a divine destiny, but our mortal minds have not yet reached that dignity. The right attitude toward our own intellect, then, is not pride but humility.
p009.s6.h: VI. The Mind-Gravity Circuit — Three Kinds of Drawing Power, and Personality
p009.s6.b0: Much as the Father draws all personality to himself and the Son attracts all spiritual reality, the Conjoint Actor exercises a drawing power on all minds. All true intellectual values, all divine thoughts and perfect ideas, are drawn into this absolute circuit of mind. Read together with the spirit gravity of Paper 7, it gives us the whole system of universe gravities at a glance.
p009.s6.b2: Personality arises from none of these. Selfhood of personality dignity does not originate in spirit, mind, or matter; it is the bestowal of the Universal Father alone, and the operation of personality gravity is always his volitional act. Beings like us, whose minds are associated with both energy and spirit, respond to spirit gravity on the spiritual side and to material gravity on the material side.
p009.s6.b3: The mind-gravity circuit is dependable, yet not every function of mind is predictable. The author conjectures that part of this unpredictability comes from the function of the Universal Absolute or the incompleteness of the Supreme Being, but states one thing he is sure of.

p009.s6.b4.q: The Infinite Spirit is the perfect expression of the mind of the Creator to all creatures; the Supreme Being is the evolving expression of the minds of all creatures to their Creator.

p009.s7.b0: The Conjoint Actor co-ordinates all levels of universe actuality so that the mental, the material, and the spiritual can be recognized at the same time. This is **universe reflectivity**: the power to see, hear, sense, and know all that happens throughout a superuniverse and to focalize all this information at any desired point. It is shown in perfection on the headquarters world of each superuniverse and finally focalizes on Paradise.
p009.s7.b1: Lines of spirit can be traced back to the Son, physical energy to Paradise, and mind to the Third Source; but in reflectivity all three are uniquely unified. The authors hold that certain features of this phenomenon can be explained only by postulating the activity of the Supreme Mind, and they suggest that reflectivity may be omniscience within the limits of the finite, the emergence of the presence-consciousness of the Supreme Being.
p009.s8.h: VIII. Personalities of the Infinite Spirit — A Ladder from Chaos to Glory
p009.s8.b0: The Infinite Spirit can transmit many of his powers to co-ordinate and subordinate personalities. His first Deity-creating act personalized the Seven Master Spirits, and every time the Father and the Son become parent to a Creator Son, the Infinite Spirit becomes ancestor to a local universe Creative Spirit. What the Infinite Spirit is to the total creation, a Creative Spirit is to a local universe.
p009.s8.b1: The section also states the marks of personality. Personality of the finite-creature variety has subjective self-consciousness and objective response to the Father’s personality circuit. There are also Third Source personalities, personal to the Spirit but not part of the Father’s personality circuit. Once we receive a morontia form, we will be able to see even those spiritual associates who are invisible to us now.

Our very ability to think and to find meaning is the Spirit’s gift, and the countless spiritual personalities who lead us upward are the Spirit’s family. At the same time the paper honestly reminds us that our minds are still immature.

p009.s9.b2: Paper 10 now turns to the Paradise Trinity, which unites the three Deities. Having followed the relation of the Son and the Spirit to the universe through Papers 7 to 9, the reader will see in the next paper how the three persons function together as one.
p010.lead: Deity unity that begins in the Father’s self-distribution and, through the union of three persons, administers justice and relates to the whole: the paper on the Paradise Trinity.

p010.foot.text: Sponsored by a Universal Censor acting by authority from the Ancients of Days resident on Uversa

p010.s0.h: Introduction — The One Inevitability in the Universe
p010.s0.b0: Having considered the Son and the Spirit in turn from Paper 6 through Paper 9, The Urantia Book now takes up the **Paradise Trinity**, which unites the three. Written by a Universal Censor, the paper begins with the claim that the Trinity frees the Father from personality absolutism. Because of the Son and the Spirit and their children, the Father is liberated from the limitations otherwise inherent in primacy, perfection, changelessness, and infinity.
p010.s0.b1: The Trinity is Deity unity. It rests eternally on the divine oneness of three original, co-ordinate, and coexistent persons: God the Father, God the Son, and God the Spirit. Looking back into the endless past, the author confesses that he can find only one inescapable inevitability in universe affairs, and that is the Trinity.

p010.s0.b2.q: The present master universe, viewed in retrospect or in prospect, is unthinkable without the Trinity.

p010.s0.b3: Given the Trinity, the affairs of the universe may be done in many different ways. Without it, however, there is no way to conceive how the Infinite could appear as three co-ordinate persons without losing the absolute oneness of Deity. The strength of the Trinity concept is that it holds together the absoluteness of unity and the freedom of three persons.
p010.s1.h: I. Self-Distribution of the First Source and Center
p010.s1.b0: Back in eternity the Father inaugurated a policy of profound **self-distribution**. He has divested himself of every part of himself that could be bestowed on any other Creator or creature, and he has delegated to his Sons every power and all authority that could be delegated. In the affairs of a local universe he has made each Creator Son just as perfect and authoritative as the Eternal Son is in the central universe.
p010.s1.b2: Sharing oneself is the mark of divine selfhood. Creatures crave association with other persons; Creators are moved to share divinity with their children. The Father bestowed the “⟦Q 10:1.4⟧personality of infinity⟦/Q⟧” upon the Son, and the two of them bestowed the “conjoint personality” of their union upon the Infinite Spirit. So the Father no longer exists alone as the unqualified personality, and if we want to know him, we must come to him through the revelation of the Son and the activity of the Spirit.
p010.s1.b3: The section closes with practical guidance. Because the Paradise Sons visit the evolutionary worlds and sometimes even live there in the likeness of mortal flesh, the creatures of the planets should look to these bestowals for trustworthy information about the Father, the Son, and the Spirit. For us, that bestowal is the life of Jesus.
p010.s2.h: II. Deity Personalization — Father, Son, and Spirit
p010.s2.b0: When the Father divests himself of the unqualified spirit personality that is the Son, by that very act he becomes the Father of the Son and gains the capacity to become the Father of all future will creatures. Then, from the infinite power of the Father-Son union, the Infinite Spirit comes forth and completes the existential personalization of Deity. The Son is indispensable to the fatherhood of God, and the Spirit is indispensable to the fraternity of the Second and Third Persons.

p010.s2.b3: Here the author reveals that he himself is of origin in the Paradise Trinity. He testifies that the three persons act individually, collectively, and in various groupings, so that in the end they function in seven different capacities. This is why the realities of the universe appear in seven variations of values, meanings, and personality.
p010.s3.h: III. The Three Persons of Deity — Seven Ways the Father Works in the Universe
p010.s3.b0: There is only one Deity, yet there are three positive personalizations of Deity. The plural wording, “⟦Q 10:3.1⟧Let us make mortal man in our own image⟦/Q⟧,” bears witness to the recognition of the three Sources and Centers. The Son and the Spirit stand in equal relation to the Father, yet in time they disclose relationships of very diverse kinds.

p010.s3.b1.q: God speaks through the Son and, with the Son, acts through the Infinite Spirit

p010.s3.b2: The Father was never alone without a Son. Fatherhood is not real without sonship, and the Son and the Spirit are coeternal with the Father. The Father has divested himself of all direct manifestations of absoluteness except absolute fatherhood and absolute volition. As a result, outside of Havona he functions in the following seven ways.

p010.s3.b4: All these relinquishments and delegations are wholly voluntary and self-imposed, not forced upon him. In an all-powerful Father who purposely limits his own authority, we see the way of love. The Son functions as a person only in the domain of the spiritual universe, while the Spirit is amazingly versatile in the spheres of mind, matter, and spirit.
p010.s4.h: IV. The Trinity Union of Deity
p010.s4.b0: Of all absolute associations, the Paradise Trinity is unique as an exclusive association of personal Deity. God functions as absolute Deity only in the Trinity and in relation to universe totality. The Trinity makes it possible to express at once the diversity of the three persons and the unity of undivided Deity.
p010.s4.b1: The author offers a crude illustration: a father, son, and grandson could form a corporate entity that is not a person yet remains subject to their personal wills. The three persons can also collaborate as individuals in any way they choose, but that collaboration is not the Trinity.

p010.s4.b3: It would be futile to try to explain fully the mystery of three as one and one acting for two. Living on the finite level, we must be content with a finite concept of the Trinity and view it according to our own enlightenment and the reactions of mind and soul. As we ascend, we will be astonished again and again as the supremacy and ultimacy of the Trinity are successively revealed.
p010.s5.h: V. Functions of the Trinity — A Union Greater Than the Sum
p010.s5.b0: The personal Deities have attributes, but the Trinity is better understood in terms of functions: justice administration, totality attitudes, co-ordinate action, and cosmic overcontrol. And this union is not an arithmetical sum of the attributes of the three; it brings forth new meanings, values, and powers.

p010.s5.b1.q: The group potential is always far in excess of the simple sum of the attributes of the component individuals.

p010.s5.b3: At the end of the section the author frankly admits that he does not command language that could convey the full truth and eternal significance of the Trinity. Passages like this, where a revelator acknowledges his own limits, teach the reader to read with humility.
p010.s6.h: VI. The Stationary Sons of the Trinity — Justice Is a Plural Function
p010.s6.b0: The paper traces the course of law and justice in four steps. Law originates in the Father; the administration of spiritual law belongs to the Son; the revelation and interpretation of law is the Spirit’s function; and the application of law, which is justice, is the province of the Trinity.

p010.s6.b2.q: Justice is never a personal attitude; it is always a plural function.

p010.s6.b3: Judgment is carried out by the Stationary Sons of the Trinity on the basis of evidence submitted by the personalities of the Infinite Spirit. These Sons form ten orders, from the Trinitized Secrets of Supremacy through the Ancients of Days and the Divine Counselors to the Universal Censors. The author of this paper belongs to the tenth order.

p010.s6.b4.q: Justice is the collective thought of righteousness; mercy is its personal expression.

p010.s6.b5: When fully understood, the righteous justice of the Trinity and the merciful love of the Father are coincident. But because we do not yet understand divine justice so deeply, in time we see love and law ministering side by side.
p010.s7.h: VII–VIII. The Overcontrol of Supremacy; The Trinity Beyond the Finite
p010.s7.b0: The three persons are equal, and they are one. Seen from the finite level, the Trinity, like the Supreme Being, is concerned only with the total: the total planet, the total universe. For this reason its overcontrol is not wholly predictable, an unpredictability that seems linked to the incompleteness of the Supreme.
p010.s7.b1: The section speaks honestly about painful events such as disasters, illnesses, and accidents. The authors admit they are not sure whether these are related to the function of the Supreme. But they add that, as time passes, they observe all such difficult situations always working out for the welfare and progress of the universes.

p010.s7.b2.q: In the progress of eternity the acts of the Trinity will be revealed as altogether meaningful and considerate, but they do not always so appear to the creatures of time.

p010.s7.b3: The final section looks at the Trinity beyond the finite. Collectively the three persons fill all Deity potential, and the finaliters, having found God as Father, must sometime begin the quest for the superfinite Father. The author confesses that he loves and worships God the Father while he respects and honors the Deity Absolute, and he closes the paper with one short sentence.

p010.s7.b4.q: Only infinity can disclose the Father-Infinite.

p010.s8.b0: Paper 10 is one of the most demanding papers theologically, yet its heart is surprisingly simple. God is one who shares himself, and through the relationships that sharing creates, he works on a larger scale. Union is greater than the sum; justice is a judgment made together, not alone; and mercy is the personal face of that justice. Even what we cannot understand now will be revealed as meaningful in eternity.

p010.s8.b2: Paper 11 describes the eternal Isle of Paradise, where the Trinity Deities dwell. After a paper on the union of three persons, we turn to the center of the universe, the material fulcrum of that union.
p011.lead: The center of the universe where the Deities dwell, the source of all energy, and the destination that ascending souls at last attain: the paper describing the eternal Isle of Paradise.

p011.foot.text: Presented by a Perfector of Wisdom commissioned thus to function by the Ancients of Days on Uversa

p011.s0.h: Introduction — A Spiritual Abode and a Material Sphere
p011.s0.b0: If Paper 10 deals with the union of the three Deities, Paper 11 describes the place where they dwell. Paradise is the eternal center of the universe of universes and the abiding place of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit and their associates. The paper first makes clear that Paradise is not only a spiritual abode but also a **material sphere**. Since all intelligent creatures live on material abodes, the absolute controlling center must also be material, literal.
p011.s0.b1: The beauty of Paradise appears in three ways: its material beauty lies in its physical perfection, its grandeur in the intellectual accomplishments of its inhabitants, and its glory in divine spirit personality, the light of life. Yet the wonder of the whole is beyond the grasp of the finite mind. There are no records or traditions about the origin of the Isle; Paradise is from eternity.
p011.s1.h: I. The Divine Residence — Where Is God?
p011.s1.b0: To creatures, Paradise exists first of all as the dwelling place of Deity. The personal presence of the Father is at the very center of the upper surface; the presence of the Son immediately surrounds it, and both are invested by the glory of the Infinite Spirit. God has always dwelt at this center and always will.
p011.s1.b1: The section compares God’s location to the cities of our world. Just as a navigator with ship, maps, and compass can find a distant city, so one who had the time, the means, the spiritual qualifications, and the guidance could journey inward from universe to universe until at last standing before the Father. Not having visited a city does not disprove its reality, and the fact that few have found God does not disprove his.

p011.s1.b2.q: That you have not visited these places in no way disproves their reality or actual existence.

p011.s1.b3: The Father is always to be found at this center. The universal lines of gravity from the ends of creation converge in him, and if he moved, universal pandemonium would follow. There are many lines we might trace, but all of them lead to the same place.

p011.s1.b5.q: Here is God personally, literally, and actually present.

p011.s2.h: II. Nature of the Eternal Isle — Absolutum, Without Time or Space
p011.s2.b0: So vast a material universe must have a capital worthy of the dignity of its Ruler. Paradise is not spherical but ellipsoid: one-sixth longer north to south than east to west, and essentially flat, its thickness one tenth of its east-west diameter. These dimensions, together with the greater out-pressure of force at its north end, make it possible to establish absolute direction in the master universe.

p011.s2.b2: The substance of the Isle is a homogeneous organization of space potency found nowhere else in the universe; the Melchizedeks of Nebadon named it **absolutum**. It is neither dead nor alive; it is the original nonspiritual expression of the First Source and Center.

p011.s2.b3.q: Paradise exists without time and has no location in space.

p011.s2.b4: Roughly speaking, space seems to originate just below nether Paradise and time just above upper Paradise. The citizens of Paradise are conscious of a nontime sequence of events rather than time, and there motion is not inherent but volitional.
p011.s3.h: III. Upper Paradise — The Father’s House, the Father’s Mansions
p011.s3.b0: Upper Paradise has three grand spheres of activity: the Deity presence, the Most Holy Sphere, and the Holy Area. The Most Holy Sphere surrounding the Deities is reserved for worship, trinitization, and high spiritual attainment; it has no material structures at all and is wholly spiritual. The author says it is useless to try to portray it to beings as material as we are.
p011.s3.b1: The outlying Holy Area is divided into seven concentric zones, often called “⟦Q 11:3.3⟧the Father’s Paradise mansions.⟦/Q⟧” The first zone is home to the Paradise Citizens and Havona natives; the second is the residential area of the ascending creatures from the seven superuniverses. This second zone is divided into seven sectors, one for each superuniverse.

p011.s3.b3: Even this unimaginable number occupies considerably less than one per cent of the assigned area of the Holy Land. There is plenty of room for those still on their way, and even for those who will not begin the Paradise climb until the eternal future. In the Father’s house there is no shortage of room.
p011.s4.h: IV. Peripheral Paradise — Where We Arrive, Where We Remember
p011.s4.b0: The Isle ends abruptly at its edge, but it is so vast that the angle is hardly discernible. All personality transports bound for Paradise land on this periphery, for neither upper nor nether Paradise can be approached by transport supernaphim or other space traversers. Here too are the force-focal headquarters of the Seven Master Spirits and the flash stations that send certain energies to the seven superuniverses.
p011.s4.b1: Peripheral Paradise holds the historic and prophetic exhibit areas assigned to the Creator Sons, seven trillion of them, now set up or in reserve. Even so, they occupy only about four per cent of the peripheral area so assigned, and the space provided is at least one million times what is actually required. The authors infer that it is reserved for creations yet to appear beyond the seven superuniverses.

p011.s4.b2.q: You must wait, and ascend while you wait

p011.s5.h: V. Nether Paradise — The Heart of Universe Energy
p011.s5.b0: We know of nether Paradise only what is revealed. Personalities do not sojourn there, and all physical-energy and cosmic-force circuits originate there. Directly beneath the location of the Trinity lies the unknown Zone of Infinity; an unnamed area surrounds it; and on the outer margins lies a vast elliptical force center concerned with space potency and force-energy.

p011.s5.b3: All force-energy originally proceeded from nether Paradise and will return there after completing its space circuit. Yet the paper makes a careful distinction: space does not originate there. Space is not force, energy, or power.

p011.s6.b0: All space alternately contracts and expands. The authors say they do not know the mechanism; they only observe it. As the pervaded space of the universes expands horizontally, the reservoirs of unpervaded space above and below Paradise contract, and the reverse. To picture their outline, think of an hourglass.

p011.s6.b2: Space does not exist on any surface of Paradise; only the quiescent midspace zones touch the Isle. A vertical cross section of all space would slightly resemble a Maltese cross. The quiet zones between space levels, together with the alternate clockwise and counterclockwise flow of the galaxies, act as a brake that keeps gravity pressure from building to disruptive levels.
p011.s7.h: VIII. Paradise Gravity — The Strand That Holds All Things
p011.s7.b0: Gravity is the all-powerful grasp of the physical presence of Paradise. The center of absolute material gravity is the Isle of Paradise, complemented by the dark gravity bodies encircling Havona and equilibrated by the space reservoirs. Space itself does not respond to gravity, but it acts as a cushion that balances it.

p011.s7.b1.q: Gravity is the omnipotent strand on which are strung the gleaming stars, blazing suns, and whirling spheres

p011.s7.b3: Space potency is not subject to any form of gravitation, yet it is ancestral to every organization of force-energy and matter. The Unqualified Absolute is the revealer and repository of all that has its source in Paradise, and its presence is likened to an elastic tension of Paradise presence. The illustration helps us grasp that everything is drawn inward toward Paradise.
p011.s8.h: IX. The Uniqueness of Paradise — Origin and Destiny
p011.s8.b0: Paradise is the realm of primal origin and the final goal of destiny for all spirit personalities. It is the geographic center of infinity, yet it is not part of universal creation, not even a real part of Havona; it is an eternal and exclusive existence.
p011.s8.b1: When the Father gave infinite personality expression to his spirit self in the Eternal Son, he simultaneously revealed the infinity potential of his nonpersonal self as Paradise. Reality was thus divided into the personal and the nonpersonal. For this reason the paper insists that Paradise cannot properly be called Deity. It is not conscious, it is not ancestral to any being, and it is not a creator; it is the absolute of patterns.

p011.s8.b2.q: Deity may cause much that is not Deity, and Paradise is not Deity

p011.s8.b3: This distinction gives an important balance to faith. We do not worship a place or a substance. Paradise is the Father’s residence and the beautiful pattern for every universe headquarters world, but the one we worship is the personal God who dwells there. The place is simply the setting for the meeting.
p011.s8.b4: The paper’s conclusion, however, is not about cosmology but about our destiny. For mortals the most important fact about Paradise is that it is the real, far-distant destination that souls ascending from the evolutionary worlds will actually reach.

p011.s8.b5.q: Every God-knowing mortal who has espoused the career of doing the Father’s will has already embarked upon the long, long Paradise trail of divinity pursuit and perfection attainment.

p011.s9.b0: Paper 11 is full of information about size, structure, and energy, but all of its descriptions point to one thing. The place we are heading toward truly exists, and ample room has been prepared there for us. God is as certainly located as a city on a map, and every circuit and every path finally converges on him. Whoever has chosen to do the Father’s will is already on the journey.

p011.s9.b2: Paper 12 takes up the universe of universes that surrounds Paradise: the space levels and the whole organization of the cosmos. Read with this paper’s picture of the Isle, space respiration, and gravity in mind, it shows how the vast universe moves in order around a single center.

p012.s0.h: Introduction — What We Can Learn Before Immensity
p012.s0.b0: If Paper 11 describes the eternal Isle of Paradise, Paper 12 surveys the whole **master universe** that spreads out around it. Even the presenter, a Perfector of Wisdom, confesses that its enormousness staggers the concept of his order of being. Yet he says that the mortal mind can be taught much about the plan and arrangement of the universes, their physical organization, and their administration.
p012.s0.b1: The paper begins with a tension. Because the Father is infinite, we may conceive of creation as infinite in principle. But the material creation we actually observe is limited at any given moment. Much of the potential of the Infinite is still unrevealed, and the revelation of the eternal purpose is still in progress.

p012.s0.b2.q: To created beings the master universe might appear to be almost infinite, but it is far from finished

p012.s0.b3: To say that the universe is not yet finished also describes our own situation. As creation grows, so do creatures. The paper begins with stars and galaxies and ends with the Father who lives in each person and with the brotherhood of all.
p012.s1.h: I. Space Levels of the Master Universe — Six Concentric Ellipses
p012.s1.b0: The universe of universes is not an infinite plane or a boundless cube; it is an organized whole with definite dimensions. As evidence, the paper points out that all basic energy forever swings around the curved paths of the space levels in obedience to Paradise gravity. If the universe were open, some energy would shoot off in a straight line into trackless space, but such behavior is never found.

p012.s1.b2: The Paradise-Havona System is the perfect and eternal nucleus of the master universe, around which the superuniverses and all regions of outer space revolve. The seven superuniverses are geographic clusterings, each holding roughly one seventh of the post-Havona creation, and together they have a potential of around seven trillion inhabited planets. Our local universe, Nebadon, is one of the newer creations in Orvonton, the seventh superuniverse, near the outer border of the grand universe.

p012.s1.b3.q: The central universe is the creation of eternity; the seven superuniverses are the creations of time

p012.s2.h: II. The Domains of the Unqualified Absolute — A Future Creation in the Making
p012.s2.b0: The space beyond the borders of the seven superuniverses is generally recognized as the **domains of the Unqualified Absolute**. The millions of universes in formation that our telescopes reveal are the outworking of the plans of the Architects of the Master Universe. The energy and matter of these outer regions already equal many times that of all seven superuniverses, yet as far as is known no mortals or angels live there, and they lie beyond the jurisdiction of the superuniverse governments.
p012.s2.b1: What, then, is all this vast preparation for? The presenter shares the belief that it will become the scene of the future activities of the assembling Corps of the Finality. It is a hint that the end of the ascent may be not rest but the beginning of new service.

p012.s2.b2.q: the endless future may hold for all of you the same enthralling spectacles that the endless past has held for your seniors and predecessors.

p012.s3.h: III. Universal Gravity — Four Absolute Circuits
p012.s3.b0: All forms of force-energy, whether material, mindal, or spiritual, are alike subject to the universal presences we call gravity. The paper names four absolute-gravity circuits in the master universe. They are not circuits of force or energy but **absolute presence circuits**, and like God they are independent of time and space.

p012.s4.h: IV. Space and Motion — A Universe That Never Rests
p012.s4.b0: Nothing in the master universe is absolutely stationary except the eternal Isle of Paradise; everything else revolves along the circuits of the space levels. On the origin of motion the presenter is cautious. He thinks the Conjoint Actor initiates motion in space but cannot prove it, and the Universal Absolute does not originate motion but equalizes the tensions it produces.

p012.s4.b2: The section also points out a trap in astronomical observation. The apparent speed at which distant outer universes seem to be receding is not real. It arises from angles of observation, time-space distortions, and above all from the fact that the neighboring outer universes revolve in the opposite direction from the grand universe: the superuniverses turn counterclockwise, while the first outer level turns clockwise.
p012.s5.h: V. Space and Time — Beings Who Look Ahead
p012.s5.b0: Time, like space, is a bestowal of Paradise, but only indirectly. Time comes by virtue of motion and because mind is inherently aware of sequence. Time and space are inseparable only in the seven superuniverses, and the only truly nontemporal place is Paradise. This is why Paradise pilgrims become unconscious during the transit from time to eternity.

p012.s5.b2: The practical conclusion of this section is short but strong. Animals know only the past and live in the present, but spirit-indwelt man can visualize the future. To remain in static ethics and traditional morality is only slightly above the animal level; only an attitude that moves forward is personally real.

p012.s5.b3.q: Only forward-looking and progressive attitudes are personally real.

p012.s6.h: VI. Universal Overcontrol — The Predictable and the Unpredictable
p012.s6.b0: The stability of the universe does not come from inertia. It is the product of balanced energies, co-operative minds, co-ordinated morontias, spirit overcontrol, and personality unification, and it is always proportional to divinity. The Father exercises physical control through the Isle of Paradise and spiritual administration through the Eternal Son, while in the domains of mind the Father and the Son function together in the Conjoint Actor.

p012.s6.b1.q: Mind alone can interassociate the physical forces and energies of the material level with the spiritual powers and beings of the spirit level.

p012.s6.b2: The universe is highly predictable only in the quantitative, gravity-measured sense. When matter, mind, and spirit are unified in a creature personality, the decisions of that freewill being cannot be fully predicted. The presenter surmises that the unexpected reactions observed in outer space disclose the presence of the Ultimate and the Absolutes. He also sets out that the appearance of the post-Havona universes depends on the Absolutes in potential, the Ultimate in direction, the Supreme in evolutionary co-ordination, and the Architects of the Master Universe in administration before specific rulers appear.
p012.s7.h: VII. The Part and the Whole — Mercy and Impartiality
p012.s7.b0: This is the warmest section of the paper. Mercy characterizes God’s attitude toward the individual; impartiality, his attitude toward the whole. God’s will does not always prevail in one person’s heart, but it does rule the universe of universes. And God’s laws are not arbitrary commands but God’s habits, his way of always doing things in the best way.

p012.s7.b1.q: The laws of God are merely the habits of God, his way of repeatedly doing things; and he ever does all things well.

p012.s7.b2: This does not make God a machine bound by law. If a situation called for a better way, God would act in that better way, and this would be the expression of a higher law, not the reversal of a lower one. He is not a mathematical equation but a freewill and primal personality, so his steadfastness is a personal and volitional faithfulness.
p012.s7.b3: On the level of personality, the paradox of the part and the whole appears as **the Fatherhood of God and the brotherhood of man**. The Father’s love makes each person a unique child without duplicate, and because that same love goes out to everyone, universal brotherhood comes into being. No one, therefore, can escape the benefits or the penalties that come from relationship with others.

p012.s7.b5.q: As moves the part, so moves the whole.

p012.s7.b6: The section ends by urging us not to be overawed by immensity. The Father dwells on Paradise, but a fragment of him lives within us to be our real and eternal self. Neither the spirit of the Son nor the seraphim can come as near to us as the Father does.
p012.s8.b0: The eighth section connects the three kinds of drawing power with the three persons of Deity. Cosmic gravity is the domain of the Isle of Paradise, spiritual gravity is the realm of the Eternal Son, and the realms of mind belong to the Conjoint Actor. Physical energy is the one reality that is steadfast in its obedience to universal law; deviation from the divine plans has occurred only in the realm of creature volition.

p012.s8.b2: The more spiritual a mind becomes, the less it responds to material gravity. Physical gravity measures the quantity of nonspirit energy; spirit gravity measures the quality of divinity. Mind, matter, and spirit are equally real, but they are not of equal value in the attainment of divinity. At death, mind (identity) and spirit survive; the body does not.

p012.s8.b3.q: Mind is the technique whereby spirit realities become experiential to creature personalities.

p012.s9.h: IX. Personal Realities — What Analysis Cannot Reveal
p012.s9.b0: The last section is about how persons are known. Love is the secret of good association between persons; we cannot know someone from a single contact, any more than a telephone number tells us anything about a person’s character. Just as no analysis of water reveals that it puts out fire, so no mathematics or chemistry could have predicted that hydrogen and oxygen would combine to form water. The whole can be more than, or different from, the sum of its parts.

p012.s9.b1.q: Love is the secret of beneficial association between personalities.

p012.s9.b2: Mortal man has a spirit nucleus, and the mind is a personal-energy system existing around that nucleus in a material environment. Real defeat and inescapable death come only when self-concepts presume to displace fully the governing power of that spirit nucleus. To whom we yield the center within us finally decides the destiny of our personality.
p012.s10.b0: Paper 12 begins like astronomy and ends as a story of faith. The universe is not yet finished and keeps growing, and that growth is held together as one whole by four gravity circuits. Within that immense whole each person is loved as a child without duplicate and at the same time shares a common destiny with everyone. And the Father is nearer to us than any other being, for he lives within us.

p013.lead: The twenty-one sacred spheres that circle nearest to Paradise: a look at the worlds of the Father, the Son, and the Spirit and the secrets kept there.

p013.s0.b0: If Paper 12 pictures the whole master universe as six concentric ellipses, Paper 13 takes us back to its very center. Between the central Isle of Paradise and the innermost circuit of Havona lie three lesser circuits of seven spheres each. Like Paradise they are eternal, and there is neither record nor tradition of their origin.

Thousands of unrevealed activities go on in these twenty-one spheres, and this paper offers only a fleeting glimpse of activities that concern the present age in one of the seven sectors of the grand universe. So the paper tells us a great deal while also honestly acknowledging that there are things it cannot tell.

p013.s1.b0: The Father’s circuit contains the only inherent personality secrets in the universe of universes and is the only forbidden domain concerned with personality in the central universe. These worlds are directed by the highest order of the Stationary Sons of the Trinity, the **Trinitized Secrets of Supremacy**. The presenter’s reason for saying little about the other secrets of Seraphington is striking: to reveal the secrets of beings so closely related that we can almost comprehend them would be akin to a betrayal of trust.
p013.s1.b7: As we read about these seven worlds, we discover how many beings have nothing to do with mortal ascension. Countless orders of spirit personalities unrevealed to us call Solitarington and Seraphington home. The presenter reminds us that every division and level of universe activity is just as fully provided with spirit ministers as is the realm that helps mortals ascend. The universe is not a stage for humans alone, and that very fact shows the fairness and generosity of its administration.
p013.s2.h: I-2. Ascendington — Where Our Own Secret Is Kept
p013.s2.b0: Of the seven worlds, the one closest to mortals is Ascendington. It is the “⟦Q 13:1.21⟧bosom of the Father, Son, and Spirit,⟦/Q⟧” the actual Paradise home of the ascendant souls of time and space until they attain Paradise status. Mortals will spend most of their Havona “vacations” there, and there the human self will enter into new relationships with the divine self.
p013.s2.b1: The secret of Ascendington is our own story: the mystery of the gradual building up, in the material and mortal mind, of a spiritual and potentially immortal counterpart of character and identity. In a word, the evolution of the immortal soul.

p013.s2.b2.q: This phenomenon constitutes one of the most perplexing mysteries of the universes—the evolution of an immortal soul within the mind of a mortal and material creature.

p013.s2.b3: Then comes a remarkable turn. To the presenter, a high Trinity-origin being, one seventh of Ascendington is forbidden, because that sector concerns a secret experienced and possessed only by beings of our type. The secret is eventually revealed to us, yet even then we never reveal it to any other order of beings. That a humble mortal comes to know by experience what a Perfector of Wisdom does not know shows how precious, on a universal scale, is the growth of the soul we are undergoing now.

p013.s2.b4.q: We know about the eternal fusion of a divine Adjuster and an immortal soul of human origin, but the ascendant finaliters know this very experience as an absolute reality.

Even as finaliters living on Paradise and serving in outer space, we will keep Ascendington as our home address and will regard it through all eternity as our home of sentimental memories. The presenter infers that ascending children of future outer universes will also look upon Ascendington as their home.

p013.s3.b1.q: As finaliters you will be domiciled on Paradise, but Ascendington will be your home address at all times, even when you enter service in outer space.

p013.s3.b5.q: When the Creator has an experiential personality secret with his creature, the Creator preserves that secret in eternal confidence.

p013.s4.h: III. The Sacred Worlds of the Eternal Son — Homes of Light Without Personality
p013.s4.b0: The seven luminous spheres of the Eternal Son are the worlds of the seven phases of pure-spirit existence and the source of the threefold light of Paradise and Havona. No personality is present there; they teem with the otherwise-than-personal beings of the Eternal Son. The presenter shares the view of the Paradise philosophers that these entities are being assembled for ministry in the new universes of outer space, and that each Paradise cycle of about two billion years sees more of them created.
p013.s4.b1: The presenter has never visited these worlds and says that, as a person, he would no doubt find them empty and deserted even if he were allowed to go. He adds a remark that is useful to us as well: high spirit personalities do not indulge in purposeless curiosity or useless adventure, because meaningful work is always abundant.

p013.s4.b2.q: There is at all times altogether too much intriguing and purposeful adventure to permit the development of any great interest in those projects which are either futile or unreal.

p013.s5.h: IV. The Worlds of the Infinite Spirit — Executive Headquarters of the Master Spirits
p013.s5.b0: The seven spheres of the outermost circuit are the executive worlds of the Seven Master Spirits and, in reality, the Paradise headquarters of the seven superuniverses. From here the Master Spirits equalize and stabilize the cosmic-mind circuits of the grand universe. Unlike the worlds of the Father or the Son, these administrative planets are open to all who can command the means of transit. The presenter confesses that when released from assignment he goes to these busy worlds to be inspired by those who enjoy doing their work.

p013.s5.b1.q: The Seven Master Spirits are, in reality, the mind-spirit balance wheel of the universe of universes

p013.s5.b2: The heart of this section explains why the presence of God is experienced differently in different places. Physical reactions are always uniform and automatic, but experiential spiritual presence varies with the receptivity of the creature.

p013.s5.b5: The Deities bestow more of their presence in response to sincere desire and withdraw when creatures decide adversely. p013.s6.b0: Paper 13 is a paper about secrets. Yet these secrets are not meant to push us away; they honor the unique experience of each order of beings. p014.lead: A billion perfect worlds around Paradise: the paper introducing Havona, the pattern of all creation and the final training ground of ascending pilgrims.

p014.foot.text: Presented by a Perfector of Wisdom commissioned thus to function by the Ancients of Days on Uversa

p014.s0.h: Introduction — A Universe Made Perfect, Not Evolved
p014.s0.b0: Paper 14 takes up **Havona**, the divine central universe at the heart of the universe of universes. Havona is the central planetary family of one billion spheres surrounding the Isle of Paradise, and all the creations of time and space revolve around it. The presenter states at the outset that its true magnitude is beyond the grasp of the human mind.

p014.s0.b1.q: This is a wholly created and perfect universe; it is not an evolutionary development.

p014.s0.b2: This one sentence is the key to the whole paper. The universe we live in is a universe of experiment and adventure, while Havona has been perfect from the beginning. The Creator Sons strive to duplicate in time and reproduce in space the perfection of this pattern universe. To know Havona, then, is to see in advance what our own universe is moving toward.
p014.s1.h: I. The Paradise-Havona System — Seven Zones of Space and the Day of God
p014.s1.b0: From the periphery of Paradise to the inner borders of the superuniverses lie seven space conditions and motions, one after another. Quiet zones alternate with moving belts, and two belts of dark gravity bodies revolve in opposite directions to balance the gravity of the central universe.

p014.s1.b2: The billion worlds of Havona are arranged in seven concentric circuits: upwards of thirty-five million in the innermost and over two hundred and forty-five million in the outermost. Each circuit is pervaded by one of the Seven Spirits of the Circuits, a specialized representation of the Infinite Spirit. The dark gravity bodies neither reflect nor absorb light, and they hide Havona from the view of even the nearby inhabited universes.
p014.s1.b3: The reckoning of time is also interesting. Time is not reckoned on Paradise, but each Havona world has its own local time determined by its circuit. The time required for the first Havona circuit to complete one revolution around Paradise is the Paradise-Havona standard day, and this is the standard time measurement for the seven superuniverses.

p014.s1.b4.q: You have unwittingly read the truth when your eyes rested on the statement “A day is as a thousand years with God, as but a watch in the night.”

p014.s2.h: II. Constitution of Havona — Threefold Energy and a Universe Without Sin
p014.s2.b0: Spirit beings do not dwell in nebulous space or on ethereal worlds. They live on material spheres just as real as the worlds of mortals. Havona’s substance, however, has an energy organization radically different from that of the evolutionary universes.
