p014.s2.b2: That is why a Urantia mortal transported to Havona would be deaf and blind there, utterly lacking in sense reactions, able to function only as a limited self-conscious being. Here we see why we must be long transformed through the mansion worlds and the superuniverse before we reach Havona.
p014.s2.b3: The urge toward God is stronger in Havona, not because spirit gravity is stronger there, but because the beings who have reached it are more fully spiritualized and so more responsive to the ever-present pull of the Son. The same drawing power is at work on us now.

p014.s2.b4.q: There has never been an instance of misconduct by any creature of any group of personalities ever created in, or admitted to, the central Havona universe.

p014.s3.h: III. The Havona Worlds — Perfect Self-Government Without Government
p014.s3.b0: Havona has no government. There are no courts and no legislative assemblies, only administrative direction. The natives are perfect by nature, and the evolutionary creatures among them long ago passed the scrutiny of the supreme tribunals of the superuniverses. Each sphere is directed by one **Eternal of Days**, a Trinity-origin personality who is not a creator but a perfect administrator and teacher.

p014.s3.b1.q: Here may be observed the height of the ideals of true self-government.

p014.s3.b2: The pilgrims of time land on the receiving worlds of the outer seventh circuit and advance inward, planet by planet and circle by circle. That only about one per cent of planetary capacity is now used for mortal ascension shows that this universe is not for us alone. There are real rivers and lakes there, but its beauty, we are told, must be seen to be understood.
p014.s4.h: IV. Creatures of the Central Universe — Life Without Decay or Death
p014.s4.b0: Life in Havona exists in seven basic forms: material, morontial, spiritual, absonite, ultimate, coabsolute, and absolute. Decay and death are no part of its cycle; even the lower living things do not decay but change form. The Havona natives are all offspring of the Paradise Trinity; they have no creature parents and do not reproduce.
p014.s4.b1: Havoners help the ascenders, yet they also live lives of their own that have meaning in themselves. The paper sets them side by side with us.

p014.s4.b2.q: Man rejoices in the goodness of God, Havoners exult in the divine beauty, while you both enjoy the ministry of the liberty of living truth.

p014.s4.b3: Havona is also home to pattern beings for every group of beings in creation. All beings in all universes are fashioned along the lines of some order of pattern creature living on one of the billion worlds of Havona, and even the mortals of time have their goal and ideals of creature existence on its outer circuits. What we are becoming already exists there.
p014.s4.b4: On every Havona world there are also attainment candidates, those who have physically reached the central universe but have not yet grown spiritually enough to claim Paradise residence. The Infinite Spirit teaches and trains them through a host of personalities of grace and glory. That learning and waiting continue even so near the destination reminds us that spiritual growth depends not on a change of place but on inner maturing.
p014.s5.h: V. Life in Havona — A University of Endless Surprises
p014.s5.b0: Each stage of the ascent has its own character. On Urantia we pass through a short and intense test; on the mansion worlds and in the local universe, the morontia phases; in the superuniverse, the true spirit stages; and on the seven circuits of Havona, intellectual, spiritual, and experiential attainment. The rules of Havona are not arbitrary, and when we arrive there we will naturally enjoy doing things the way they should be done.

p014.s5.b3.q: Monotony is not a part of the Havona career.

p014.s6.b5: Havona is not only the established destiny of mortals but also the starting place of the finaliters’ new adventure of exploring the infinity of the Father. The presenter foresees that Havona’s potentials are really unlimited and that it will serve forever as an experiential training universe for all types of created beings, past, present, and future.
p014.s7.b0: Paper 14 shows us ahead of time the destination of our journey. Havona is a universe made perfect rather than evolved, a place where everyone gladly walks the right way, so that no government is needed. And it is not a static paradise but a university of endless surprises. The curiosity and longing to grow within us now are seeds of that life.
